source.regulation: 2026 Formula 1 Regulations — Section B [Sporting], Issue 08, Article B7.2

eventEntryRequirements.purpose: An entry is used only when every field below is populated from an official FIA Competition appendix or equivalent FIA event document.
eventEntryRequirements.rule: Never infer missing values from another circuit, a broadcast graphic, a previous season, or the generic analysis filter.

restrictions: Historical Overtake/DRS control data is not reconstructed from an official event appendix.
FIA publishes the detection gap, detection line, activation line, applicable power limits and Recharge limits per Competition.
Overtake is disabled before a TTCS start/resumption, during a Safety Car deployment and in Low Grip Conditions; the Race Director may disable or re-enable it for safety.
